Bill.BriefDescription: Exempting wholesale sales of bulk raw milk from business and occupation tax.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to exempting wholesale sales of bulk raw milk frombusiness and occupation tax; and amending RCW 82.04.332.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 82.04.332 and 1998 c 312 s 2 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: This chapter does not apply to amounts received from buying bulkraw milk, wheat, oats, dry peas, dry beans, lentils, triticale, canola,corn, rye, and barley, but not including any manufactured productsthereof, and selling the same at wholesale.
